title: pcapng: remove a no-longer-needed union.
description:
A custom_binary_opt_t will never contain any structures specific to a
particular PEN - that gets in the way of arbitrary custom options.
Remove the union.

While we're at it, remove PEN_NFLX from wiretap/wtap_opttypes.h; either
we should have a generic header - in wsutil, as it'd be used both by
libwiretap and libwireshark - containing PENs, or we should put each PEN
in the libwiretap header for that particular PEN's custom data.  Do the
latter, for now.

>  either we should have a generic header - in wsutil, as it'd be used both by libwiretap and libwireshark - containing PENs,

This would be a "#define macros to PEN" lookup like `epan/oui.h`, rather than the "PEN to string" lookup that the automatically generated `epan/enterprises.[ch]` provides (analogous to the `manuf*` files)?

> This would be a "#define macros to PEN" lookup like `epan/oui.h`, rather than the "PEN to string" lookup that the automatically generated `epan/enterprises.[ch]` provides (analogous to the `manuf*` files)?

It would, but, as we already have one, "put each PEN in the libwiretap header for that particular PEN's custom data" may be the right way to handle this in the long run - most PENs will probably not be used for custom blocks or options.
